messages:
Jamie: Quick sync — planning canary for model v3.2 tomorrow morning. Proposal: percent-based ramp + region gating. Start at 1% global for first 30m, then ramp to 5% in us-west-2 and 3% in eu-west-1 over the next 4 hours. Need guardrails, abort conditions, and flag naming. Thoughts?

Maria: Sounds good. Key metrics to watch: p95 latency, error rate (5xx and 4xx), 429s, token cost delta, and model quality on the smoke prompts. Also watch retry counts.

Lin: +1. Suggest concrete thresholds: abort if p95 increases > 200ms vs baseline for 5 consecutive mins OR if errors > 1% sustained for 5m. Hold windows between steps: 30m after each increment. Ramp steps: 1% -> 3% -> 5% -> 10% (only if all checks green).

Sophie: Flag naming idea: `ff:model:v3:canary` with rollout id metadata e.g. `rollout:2026-03-18-01`. Scope keys: `region`, `route`, `account`. Also add an immediate kill-switch: `ff:model:v3:kill`. Documented in the runbook.

Akshay: Ops notes: automatic fallback to v2 if abort triggered. Abort definition we use in monitoring: p95 > 800ms OR error rate > 1% OR 429s spike > 2x baseline for 5m. Also add cost guardrail: if token cost per request increases > 20% over baseline for 30m, pause ramp and notify.

Akshay: Example toggle CLI (for ops automation):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/flags/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"flag":"ff:model:v3:canary","action":"set","percent":5,"regions":["us-west-2"]}'
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: model-v3.2 build 2026-03-18-01 to inference fleet. Canary start time: 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z.

Jamie: I'll open the rollout config PR with the exact step timings and the smoke prompt set. @ops, @lin can you confirm monitors before 01:00 UTC?

ops-bot: Monitors created: `canary-model-v3-p95`, `canary-model-v3-error-rate`, `canary-model-v3-429s`, `canary-model-v3-cost-delta`. Pager rules: notify #eng-oncall then oncall@redwood if abort condition met.

Lin: Confirmed. I'll sync the smoke evals and add a quality regression alert that checks BLEU/ROUGE-ish metrics on the sample set. If quality drops > 3% relative to v2, pause ramp.

Sophie: I'll draft the runbook with rollback steps and post it in #eng-sre. Link will be added to the PR.

Jamie: Perfect. Last check — do we want region-only rollout first (restrict to us-west-2) rather than global 1%? Pros: easier blast radius. Cons: missing cross-region failure modes. Thoughts?

Maria: Leaning region-first. Start us-west-2 at 5% then mirror to eu-west-1 if green. Keeps blast small and still exercises routing.

Jamie: Ok region-first. I'll update PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
